features.name: Shopify B2B Companies with Multiple Locations
features.description: Support for importing Shopify B2B companies that have multiple locations, each representing different business or legal entities. Locations can have different addresses, payment terms, and buyers.
caveats: Each legal entity must be represented as a customer in Business Central

features.name: Shopify Orders Import
features.description: Ability to import orders from Shopify into Business Central. Orders from multiple locations can be synchronized and assigned to appropriate customers.

features.name: Shopify Companies List
features.description: A new list in Business Central that displays Shopify companies and includes a fact box showing the number of locations associated with each company.
caveats: Companies are mapped to customers by tax ID

features.name: Shopify Locations List
features.description: A new list page that displays Shopify company locations with their addresses, tax information, and payment terms. Includes sell-to and bill-to customer number fields for mapping.

features.name: Location-to-Customer Mapping
features.description: Ability to map Shopify locations to different sell-to and bill-to customers in Business Central. Enables advanced scenarios where multiple locations of a company are represented by different customers.
caveats: Advanced mapping scenarios may require manual configuration

features.name: Order Synchronization with Location Mapping
features.description: When orders are synchronized from Shopify, the sell-to and bill-to customers are automatically assigned based on the location mappings configured in the Shopify Locations list.

features.name: Push Business Central Customers to Shopify
features.description: Ability to create Shopify companies with locations from existing Business Central customers. The connector can add multiple customers as Shopify locations and populate their tax, address, and payment term information.
caveats: Required to have existing customers in Business Central with appropriate tax and address information

features.name: Automatic Catalog Creation for Locations
features.description: When creating Shopify companies from Business Central customers, the connector can automatically create separate catalogs for each location if configured to do so.
caveats: Requires configuration setting to enable automatic catalog creation
